paint.viewer.override

Class ExportOverridesFromViewer

  • java.lang.Object
    • paint.viewer.override.ExportOverridesFromViewer

  • public class ExportOverridesFromViewer
extends Object
    Provides functionality to apply and export manual overrides and exclusions from the PAINT viewer. This class processes recording-level overrides, square-level overrides, and recording-level exclusions, merging them back into the main project CSV files.

      • exportOverrides

        public static void exportOverrides(Path projectPath,
                                   String extension)
        Executes the full override/exclude procedure on the given project path.

        Inputs are read from the project root. Override/exclude instructions are read from <project>/Viewer. Outputs are written back into the project root with a suffix (default: -override).

        Parameters:
        projectPath - project root directory
        extension - suffix added to output CSV files (e.g. -override)

      • applyRecordingOverrides

        public static void applyRecordingOverrides(tech.tablesaw.api.Table recordingsTable,
                                           tech.tablesaw.api.Table squaresTable,
                                           List<RecordingOverride> overrides)
        Applies all RecordingOverride rows to the recordings table and recomputes square visibility for affected recordings.
        Parameters:
        recordingsTable - target Recordings table (mutated in-place)
        squaresTable - target Squares table (mutated in-place)
        overrides - parsed override rows

      • applySquareOverrides

        public static void applySquareOverrides(tech.tablesaw.api.Table squaresTable,
                                        List<SquareOverride> overrides)
        Applies all SquareOverride rows to the squares table.

        Only rows matching the composite key (experimentName, recordingName, squareNumber) are updated.

        Parameters:
        squaresTable - target Squares table (mutated in-place)
        overrides - parsed override rows

      • applyRecordingExcludes

        public static void applyRecordingExcludes(tech.tablesaw.api.Table recordingsTable,
                                          Path projectPath)
        Applies recording excludes from Viewer/Recording Exclude.csv by setting the "Exclude" flag in the provided Recordings table.

        This method does not delete rows from other tables; the caller may choose to remove excluded recordings from Squares/Tracks.

        Parameters:
        recordingsTable - target Recordings table (mutated in-place)
        projectPath - project root directory
